title: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand [Hindi]
description: S-rank mage Luck sacrifices everything to defeat the Demon King. Returning ten years later to a world that mourns him as a dead legend, he hides his identity and starts over as "Lock," an F-rank adventurer building a new life from scratch.

title: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire [Hindi]
description: From his deathbed, Hero-King Inglis, the divine knight and master of all he surveys, gazes down on the empire he built with his mighty hand. Having devoted his life to statecraft and his subjects' well-being, his one unfulfilled wish is to live again, for himself this time: a warrior's life he'd devoted himself to before his rise to power. His patron goddess, Alistia, hears his plea and smiles upon him, flinging his soul into the far future. Goddesses work in mysterious ways, so not only is Inglis now the daughter of a minor noble family, but at her first coming-of-age ceremony at 6, she's found ineligible to begin her knighthood. However, for a lady of Inglis's ambition, this is less a setback and more the challenge she was (re)born to overcome. "It's not the blood that runs through your veins that makes a knight; it's the blood you shed on the battlefield". The curtain rises on the legend of an extraordinary lady squire reborn to master the blade.

description: Episode 1 : An office worker who lost his job and doesn’t even have a girlfriend gets caught by a group of gyarus! The middle-aged man, inexperienced with women, is relentlessly teased and played with by the shameless gyarus! Whether it’s in the living room, the bath, or even the futon, their “inspection” of him never stops! title: A Prince in a Pawnshop
description: David Solomon, a wealthy banker, is merciless in his dealings with his rich clients, from whom he exacts the highest interest. He aids the poor as much as possible. To facilitate his kindness among the people of the Ghetto, he runs there a pawnshop, unlike all others, for to the needy he measures out money, not according to the value of the articles they offer, but according to their needs. David's son, Maurice, is given to high living. It grieves his father, who is, however, consoled by the fact that his daughter, Ethel, seconds her father's charities by maintaining a day nursery for the children of the poor. One day David sees a young girl fall unconscious in the street. He takes her to the hospital where the doctor tells him that the girl, Mary, is suffering from exhaustion. David's heart is touched and he resolves to make Mary's future his own care. When she has regained her strength he finds her a position as a model in a dress house of a friend, Silver. Ethel visits the dress house to buy gowns, bringing Maurice with her. He sees Mary for the second time, having noticed her upon the street. Maurice arranges to meet Mary under an assumed name, and pursues his courtship with all seeming love. She so learns to worship Maurice that she gives him all, not stopping to count the cost, nor to demand the wedding ring. For a brief while Mary tastes of a great happiness, but Stevins, the man for whom she once worked, and who, because she would not encourage his advances, drove her from every honest position, naming her as a thief, visits the dress house to get gowns for "The Bunch of Flowers," a set of girls so termed by Maurice who has been much in their company. He recognizes Mary, repeats the accusation, and her employer discharges her. Mary returns to the little flat supported by Maurice, where she tells her story. Maurice has begun to tire of her. He seeks Stevins, who tells a seemingly truthful story. Maurice believes it and leaves Mary, writing to this effect. He, however, does not know that the girl he has wronged is about to become a mother. Six years elapse, and we find Mary and her little son, living in poverty. Again she is rescued by David Soloman, who has called to see a deserving case next door to Mary, the object of his charity being Mrs. Payne, the landlady who drove Mary from her door, and who is now a paralytic. title: A Bomb for a Dictator
description: A revolution breaks out in a South American country while its cruel dictator is on a trip to France. The rebels have made careful plans to blow up the dictator's private plane as he returns, but at the last second he changes plans and travels on a commercial flight. title: A Guy, a Gal and a Pal
description: A young woman devises a clever scheme to secure a train reservation by pretending to be married to a stranger.

title: A Kingdom for a Crown
description: The Royal Family is a beloved, yet controversial staple of the United Kingdom. From the beloved Queen, to Prince Harry and Meghan choosing to live in another country, to the acrimonious divorce of Charles and Diana, to Prince Andrew's sex scandal, this cheeky documentary covers it all.

title: A Brit and a Broad
description: A travel video blog that brings people and places to you at home.

title: A Day at a Time
description: Alba and Anastasia are twins with cerebral palsy who touched the heart of President Clinton with their plea for equal access. They come from an extraordinary family where everyone is determined the twins will be included in all activities. The fact that they are both in wheelchairs does not keep them from school, summer camp, or church. Their mother, Mary, thinks nothing of carrying them up and down several flights of stairs in their wheelchairs. She is a woman in constant motion, bathing, dressing, feeding and taking pleasure in seeing the twins are attractively dressed. She uses her tenacity and charm to assure that her children receive all the medical and educational benefits to which they are entitled. The filmmakers became close to the family, capturing the milestones of their lives: a birthday party, days at summer camp, their joyous first communion in church. Filmed over a period of four years, this unforgettable story will inspire everyone concerned with the challenges of family life and the place of disabled children in our society.

title: A Life, a Manifesto
description: Michèle Firk, film critic, aspiring director, revolutionary activist who championed justice and freedom. A Life, A Manifesto chronicles a woman who defied convention, embracing free love, cinema, and revolution.

title: 2054: A Princess, A Soldier, and A Tailor
A Girl in a Million
description: A young scientist freed by divorce from a nagging wife, isolates himself from women. His peace is broken by a lovely young girl to whom he is forced to give shelter. He marries her and finds that his dumb wife is not so dumb.

title: A Year in a Village
description: The documentary A Year in a Village features a village in Moravia, Czech Republic. The focus is on 12-year-old Vojta and his father Danek, who are both into beekeeping and on Vojta's 16-year-old cousin Anetka, who is preparing for her first participation in "hody" celebration, and of their grandmother Bohuska. We watch the members of the family work and perform their hobbies. We listen to their opinions, trying to understand their thinking, as well as the world they live in. Even though a part of the documentary features the traditional feast called "hody", the aim is not to describe the event itself, but to understand how the characters feel about being a part of it and how it influences them.

title: A Burglar for a Night
description: In Hong Kong, William Neal helps Kirk Marden fight off a group of rowdies. Back in New York, Kirk again turns to William's assistance when his father's rivals plot to take control of the Marden railroad. William teaches Kirk how to open safes so that Kirk can procure papers outlining the takeover plans. While Kirk is robbing the safe, Janet Leslie, daughter of one of the conspirators, enters, and Kirk forces her to marry him so that she cannot testify against him. Kirk succeeds in reconciling his father with his rivals and in winning his new wife's love.

title: You S1-S5
description: A charming and intense young man inserts himself into the lives of women who fascinate him.

title: A Glória e a Graça
description: Graça is a single mother who works as a massage therapist and lives with her two children: Moreno, 8, and Papoula, 15. One day, in a visit to the doctor, Graça is diagnosed with a brain aneurism that may rupture at any moment. Desperate about who will take care of her kids in the event of her death, she decides to go after her brother, Luiz Carlos, whom she hasn't seen in over 15 years due to a quarrel. When they meet, however, Luiz Carlos has become Gloria, a beautiful and successful transvestite, who now owns a restaurant and brags about being independent. At first, Gloria is unwilling to reconnect with her family; but as she becomes more guilt-stricken, she accepts Graça's invitation to meet her nephews and eventually realizes that maybe, to be complete, she needs to become a mother.

title: A Woman Is a Woman
description: The film follows two trans women in Hong Kong - Chiu Ling Fung is still at school but has been wrestling with their gender identity. Meanwhile Sung Chi Yu has been happily married for ten years, but has kept a secret from her family.

title: A Guy and a Gal
description: Hypochondriac Lasse can and does pull the girls with no trouble, although for a short while this causes a real and painful health problem. Meeting Lena while delivering papers - the nearest he has got to his favoured career of journalism - he finds himself getting serious. But he seems unable, or unwilling, to give up the girls, his phobia, and work-shy lifestyle. Something will have to give.

title: A Whisper to a Roar
description: Courageous democracy activists in five countries (Egypt, Malaysia, Ukraine, Venezuela and Zimbabwe) risk it all to bring freedom to their people.

title: A Faxineira é a Verdadeira CEO
description: Ferida após o serviço militar, Sophie conhece Sabrina, noiva de seu irmão Chris, mas é brutalmente humilhada pela família da moça, que ignora sua real identidade. Para proteger o irmão, ela se infiltra como faxineira na empresa dele para expor os abusos e esquemas de Sabrina. Por fim, Sophie revela sua identidade na festa de gala da companhia e assume o comando como CEO.

title: A Squirrel and a Hedgehog
description: Two teenagers (Geumsaegi and Juldarami) fight against an evil army.

title: A Man, a Woman, and a Killer
description: A MAN, A WOMAN, AND A KILLER is the story of a small-time gangster (Dick Richardson) writing his journal in a Mendocino, California, farmhouse, as he awaits a hit man who is coming to kill him. In this first part of a trilogy, realities continue to shift between the story, and the actual making of the film, as seen through unscripted scenes, real-life narrations by lead actors, and the real relationship that developed on the set between Richardson and the actress (Carolyn Zaremba) who played his girlfriend. A bumbling, local librarian (played by Ed Nylund) is mistaken for the "killer" and plays along with the game.

title: A Girl, a Boy, a Penny and a Very, Very, Very Long Road
description: A whimsical road-trip drama about grief, mental health, lost dreams, and the unanswerable question of who we truly are. This heartfelt quirky drama is an indie film that inspires trust, self-love, and bravery.

title: A General, a Scholar and a Eunuch
description: Three Ming dynasty imperial officials accidentally travel to modern day Mainland China while searching for a missing princess.

title: A Fist for a Fist
description: Kung-Fu Superstar Chen Hui Man (Chinese Super Ninja) is the righteous fighter with the invincible fists. Or so he thought. The dreaded Silver Fox gives him the run of his life in this action packed spectacular. Chen Hui Min is in the role of a lifetime, playing a good guy in a career dominated by bad guy and gangster role. His off screen life is just as action packed as his films.

title: A Day in a Life
description: A DAY IN A LIFE tells the story of five seniors who decide to turn an ordinary day into something special. Produced and Directed by Canadian poet JEAN MERCIER, this film will stay with you for a long long time.

title: A Dream
description: An inspirational story about an actor chasing his dreams while struggling to provide for his family.

title: A Geisha
description: A seasoned geisha and her apprentice maiko are forced to give in to their clients' sexual advances to survive.

title: In A Day and A Night
description: As Khaled's financial situation goes downhill, he faces failures in his work besides his father's illness and heart surgery, with having a nightmare in which he will be involved in an accident that will turn his life head over heels.

title: A Sister
description: A night. A car. Alie is in danger. To get by she must make the most important phone call of her life.

title: Not a Feather But a Dot
description: A look at the history, perceptions, and evolution of the Indian-American community.

title: A Ilha
description: A millionaire invites some friends for a weekend on an island which some say is the site of buried treasure. But a storm takes the boat away, and the people stay isolated from the rest of the world. In these conditions, everybody starts to show their real natures and characters.

title: A tanítónö
description: This literary adaptation from a well known Hungarian author is the story of a schoolmistress.

title: A Viagem
description: After she dies, the spirit of a woman must prevent the angry, rancorous ghost of her suicidal brother from harming their family.

title: Cathy, A Mom Making A Difference
A Dollar and a Grave
description: An American drifter becomes involved in a deadly family dispute. A powerful Mexican rancher orders the killing of his daughter's boyfriend. Jones earns the wrath of the father when he finds the body and buries it.

title: A Banquet
description: A widowed mother is radically tested when her teenage daughter insists a supernatural experience has left her body in service to a higher power.

title: A tanyagondnok
description: The farmsteads of the Great Plain are the treasures of European settlement history. The question is how long they will stay. It is a fact that in Hungary the farm world has been dying for decades. More than one-third of the farms in the Great Plain are elderly, often incapacitated, completely isolated from the outside world. Their living conditions are often worse than those of people living in distant, exotic Third World countries. All this in 2014, in the heart of Europe. The survival of the farm world, and often the survival of the people living there, would be almost impossible without the various custodial services and their charismatic staff that have been operating in Hungary for more than twenty years and supplying the people living on the farms with virtually everything they need. Our film presents the often heroic daily lives of these dedicated people, while providing a comprehensive picture of the 21st-century Hungarian homeland and the lives of those living there, which is increasingly becoming a tragic memento of a sinking world. One of the hundreds of caretakers in Hungary is Márta Farkas. Through the activities of a caretaker, we show the last living witnesses and representatives of the lives and struggles of survivors of everyday life in the Great Plain and the struggle for survival in everyday life and a disappearing lifestyle and peasant culture.

title: A Cappella
description:
The movie is set in 1969, when Japanese students were enmeshed with campus riots, anti-war rallies, and the growth of subcultures in music, cinema, literature, and theater. Influenced by the atmosphere of the time, the protagonist, Kyôko, a senior at a high school for girls, forms an "Anti-Uniform Committee" and joins a rally at a university. However, Kyôko hates herself because she knows she is only copying others. One day, she is wounded at a rally, and realizes she has been taking campus riot for granted. Fleeing from the riot police, she runs into "A Cappella," the café where she meets and falls in love with a college student, named Wataru. She undergoes a sexual awakening and loses her virginity. Things seem to be going well with Wataru, but then she witnesses something she cannot believe...

 This film depicts the emotional rollercoaster of being a teenager. Love, hurt, betrayal and rebellion all play a role. "A Cappella" is a coming-of-age tale, where one finds something important and grows up by losing it

title: What's a Podcast? A Documentary Film
description: Podcasting is the new Punk Rock! Podcasting saved my life. What IS a Podcast? Podcasting is a new digital communications medium that is not only changing the way people consume media, it is changing peoples lives. Through my journey, I have met fellow podcasters, and listeners, whom I now call friends. The inspiration and comfort this medium gives to so many is a story that hasn't yet received the attention it deserves. In 2009 things went crazy for me and my family. We were living in Virginia when I was downsized, leaving us with a mortgage and a feeling of What now? Times were tough. No one was hiring. This downward spiral lasted for a few years, forcing us to return home to New Jersey to live with relatives. I was in a deep, dark depression. At my lowest, I picked up a book from the famous movie director and podcast pioneer, Kevin Smith. The book gave me permission to do something crazy, if not desperate. Do it Start a podcast Go talk on the internet with your friends. And so I did, starting my own highly successful podcast: ThatMan on Fatman. But this film is not just about my journey. Its the journey of the many podcasters, and listeners, friends and family, and how this medium is changing, helping, and even saving peoples lives, let alone building communities. The world is now at everyone's fingertips and podcasters are the pioneers of a new digital age and medium. Please join me in this insider look of a world heading for tomorrow.

description: Private Internal Troops Andrei Ivin is a security guard in a strict regime zone. A recidivist nicknamed Mishka Knyaz escapes. Private Ivin could not shoot him, and he was forced to go under the tribunal himself. In an explanatory note, he writes that he "refuses to continue to dispose of someone else's life." Under the supervision of the company commander Narotiev, he is sent to the disbat. Senior Lieutenant Narotiev is almost the same age as Ivin. It's hard for him to believe that the private is telling the truth. title: Paraíso B
description: A visually striking film with a strong social critique. Illegal horse-race betting and "The Boss"; a man without mercy; two of his employees and the sister of one of them; forced to decide between saving his brother or beginning a new life.

title: B.B.O
description: A Singer/entertainer realizes how much of an impact her image as a female superstar has on the youth.

title: Bombers B-52
description: Sgt. Chuck Brennan always disliked playboy and hotshot, Col. Jim Herlihy. Now Chuck has even more reason to, Jim is dating his daughter, Lois.

title: Annie B.
description: Annie is an active and lively teenager. Fernando owns an ad agency. Annie halts Fernando's wedding, mistaking him for her sister's boyfriend. The two meet again when Annie auditions for a TV commercial. Despite their start, the two get to know and like each other.

title: B. Boppin'
description: Buzz Boppin' is the coolest bee on his block and his colorful Honeycomb Hangout is where all the kids swarm when school is out and class is in session.

title: B.O.B.'s Big Break
description: Join B.O.B., Dr. Cockroach and The Missing Link for dynamite action and mind-blowing adventure. The good doctor celebrates B.O.B.'s birthday with a cake that's just 'the bomb.' After he swallows the explosive, B.O.B. mysteriously has the power to read other creature's minds.

description: Rival gangs fight over a cocaine shipment. One of the gangs, led by a ruthless woman named Lan Di, has a superhumanly powered assassin named Scorpion at her disposal.

title: Bar-B-Q
description: After a football-pro-turned-actor (John West) returns home to Atlanta for relaxation, he throws a barbecue for his friends that gets out of control.

title: Looking S2
description: Three best friends living in San Francisco share the nuances and complexities of contemporary gay relationships as they explore a variety of options, both in love and in life.

title: B
description: July 15, 2013 Luis Barcenas - Old party treasurer was transferred from prison to National Court to testify. Previously, he had denied everything. Today he will tell the truth.

title: Plan B
description: Et si c'était possible de faire marche arrière dans le temps pour modifier le cours des événements et changer sa destinée? Et si une deuxième chance nous était offerte? Et si c'était possible grâce à Plan B - Le jour où Philippe perd l'amour de sa vie, Evelyne, il découvre une invraisemblable compagnie du nom de Plan B qui offre la possibilité de revenir dans le passé. Après un premier essai fructueux, Philippe réalise l'immense pouvoir que lui donne ce stratagème. Il voudra donc aussi s'en servir au profit de son cabinet d'avocats qu'il possède avec son associé/ami/beau-frère Patrice et pour remettre son frère André sur le droit chemin. Mais Philippe réalisera qu'un choix nouveau, aussi minime soit-il, a des répercussions aussi incontrôlables qu'insoupçonnées sur sa vie et celle des autres. Plus rien ne sera sans conséquence. Le jeu en vaut-il la chandelle? Valait-il mieux accepter son véritable destin?

title: Scare B&B

title: Tamon's B-Side [English]
description: High schooler Utage works as a housekeeper and idolizes Tamon from F/ACE. When assigned to clean his home, she finds he's actually shy and gloomy offstage - yet she falls for his true self.

description: Burlesque beauties performing their signature striptease acts, accompanied by comedians, testing the moral boundaries.

title: B&B Vol Liefde
description: Reality series in which six single B&B owners spread over Europe go looking for the love of their lives. Which Dutch partner dares to look across the border and make the B&B owners' adventure complete?

title: Ivelisse vs Izzy B
description: Kelsey Raegan wears the stripes and you can tell from the introductions that she may not be impartial here. Ivelisse eats youngsters like Izzy for snacks, but Izzy challenges her to a most knockouts within the time limit rules match. Ivelisse comes out blasting with roundhouse kicks, turnbuckle smashes and face slams. She mounts Izzy for a straitjacket choke that quickly secures the first knockout. Izzy took her lumps but learned her lessons and after a back and forth fight she uses the same hold to kayo the veteran! Ivelisse is livid, but Kelsey is thrilled and the battle continues. Ivelisse takes the fight to Izzy, putting her out with a choking facelock and back mounted Camel Clutch, but each time Izzy manages to mimic her opponent’s offense and knocks Ivelisse out using her own holds. Tied in falls and with time ticking down, the pair brawl for control. Ivelisse nails the lanky blonde with kicks, stomps and chokes before driving her face first into the turnbuckles. Can Ivelisse put the youngster down once more to secure the win, or will Izzy prove herself against the veteran…and will Kelsey stay out of the fight?

title: Killer B & B
description: Eight influencers aspiring to be actresses and a camera crew are set up in a lavish estate for a social media event, hosted by superstar actress, Starr Burrell. Unbeknownst to them all, a serial killer is in their midst. He has them all trapped and has planned a sinister weekend that any of them would be lucky to escape. A Modern-Day horror film that seemingly makes "The Escape Room" meet "Psycho."

title: Planet B
description: Thirteen-year-old Bo grows up in a protected environment where everything seems possible, but she is frightened by the dark predictions of the future. Together with her friend Luka, she decides to take up the fight against climate change and they join Extinction Rebellion. They occupy factory sites and highways, they are arrested and criticized. But what are politicians doing? Why does all this take so long? As Luka proposes increasingly radical actions, the more thoughtful Bo wants to find her own way. But how can she continue in a world that is eating away at her own future? PLANET B is a coming-of-age story of two youngsters exploring how to grow up in a world destroying itself.

title: Mr. Kinpachi in Class 3B
description: Kinpachi Sakamoto is the homeroom teacher for a group of third-year students known as the "B-Group". The students are from a wide range of backgrounds, and have an equally wide range of hopes, plans and problems. Mr. Sakamoto sticks by every one of his students, doing his best to help all of them realize their dreams. This series is frequently restarted, with a new class of students each year.

title: B-Town Grubdown
description: These food enthusiasts take on challenges in Bakersfield, California. Big appetites and big laughs in this on going web series from Hectic Films.

title: Point B
description: Four friends and Graduate students in the physics department of their University discover their clean energy machine actually works as a crude, rudimentary teleportation device. Through experimentation, adjustments and some misuse-use of the device, it is quickly discovered that the machine holds many consequences.

title: Mr Joe B. Carvalho [Hindi]

title: Spring of the Blade
description: After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

title: Lee & Cindy C.
description: Lee is a musician and plays in a band together with his high school friends. He wants to build a musical career but realizes his less then talented friends aren't going to take him anywhere. Luckily, he has the support of his uncle, Dolf. A second rate clown and an alcoholic. Cindy C is a Flemisch crooner who want to revive her career. However, she struggles with her conscience and no longer wishes to lie and cheat in the pitfall that is show business. When Lee and Cindy C meet, two different worlds collide and they will have to fight for their love.

title: Sex Lessons With My Forbidden Alpha
description: When wolfless eighteen-year-old Avery asks her newly returned childhood best friend, Dean, to teach her how to seduce the golden-boy Alpha she has wanted forever, their no-feelings sex lessons ignite a dangerous attraction that forces her to choose between the perfect crush she imagined and the forbidden Rogue Alpha who has always chosen her.

title: Shadow Punisher
description: The Great Dynasty, which had been in good luck for 37 years, was about to usher in a long planned bloody storm. Puppet secret techniques, Changsheng Demon Luo, Winged Poison Worm, Mirror Flower Water Moon, and the Teacher of Form and Man appeared one after another. The "Five Absolute Mysteries" revived with the help of the defeated country's Li Luo, creating a series of shocking and mysterious cases. The group of divine catchers led by Li Si, under the direct jurisdiction of the Imperial Power, resolutely opened the curtain of their life and death struggle against the remnants of Li Luo in order to ensure the safety of the mountains and rivers and the well-being of the people.

title: Sky C.
description: Sofia (AKA Sky) is a single mom supporting her daughter and her father. Growing up in the gym watching her father train to become a professional boxer her passion has always been to become a MMA pro-fighter. Her father's dream was cut short in the fight that would make him a professional boxer, when he sustained a spinal injury confining him to a wheelchair. Now her father is adamantly against Sky having any part of fighting for fear of her succumbing to the same fate he endures. But Sky passion for fighting could not be extinguished, so she continued to train in between working, being a mother and caretaker. After losing her main source of income, financial struggles ensue that forces her to secretly take underground fights to make money to support her family. One night she knocks out an opponent and it turns out to be the current MMA champion. The crowd has it all on video and the footage goes viral causing the MMA champion to challenge her to a real match that proves that Sky's knockout was just lucky. The viral footage gets back to her father and he further finds that his best friend was part of her training. The father confronts them both and the argument reveals the truth of why he didn't want Sky to fight. Sky leaves with her daughter and begins training for the fight of her life, without her father, until the day of the fight.

title: The Blossoming Love
description: Ancient Emperor Zhao Ming and lover Hun Dun Zhu reincarnate as rivals Xie Xue Chen and Mu Xuan Ling. While seeking divine artifact, enemies become allies and fall in love. After her sacrifice, he time travels to save her.

title: Love is Sweet [Hindi]
description: It follows the story of a girl named Jiang Jun who meets her close childhood friend, Ma Yuanshuai, in the workplace-this time, however, not as an ally but as a rival - Jiang Jun is an educated woman with a double degree in economics and psychology. Her parents liberal ways of raising her gave rise to her strong, independent, and idealistic character. After graduating from college, she begins to work for a non-profit organization to follow her dream of helping others. However, her father's sudden death leaves her on a crucial crossroad in her life. She decides to join MH, a top investment company, to fulfill her father's dying wish. Jiang Jun runs into her childhood friend Ma Yuanshuai, yet he's different from the gentle and caring protector that she remembered him to be. He is now her rival at work. Furthermore, someone seems to be plotting against her and she must rely on her wits and will to succeed not just in her career, but also in love.

title: Shifter Academy 2: In Heat with my Wild Mate
description: One wrong turn. Three naked shifters. One very unimpressed human. Nora shrugs at the dragon prince—so he floods campus with pheromones and sends everyone into heat. Everyone except her. She’s immune. He’s obsessed. Now Nora must survive jealous enemies, forbidden attraction, and three powerful men determined to claim her heart.

title: La macchina delle immagini di Alfredo C.
description: At the end of the Second World War, the Communist Party took power in Albania. In the country there were still about 27,000 Italian veterans and civilians. They were prevented to go back home. Among them there was also a cameraman.

title: Sweet Trap [Hindi]
description: Cooking apprentice Li Nai sees her chef lose a cooking battle to Jiang Jie. As a result, the chef loses his 5 stars and has to close the restaurant. Li Nai wants to avenge him, unaware she used to be friends with Jiang Jie.

title: Charlotte
description: The story takes place in an alternate reality where a small percentage of children manifest superhuman abilities upon reaching puberty. A focus is placed on Yuu Otosaka, a high school boy who awakens the ability to temporarily possess others, which brings him to the attention of Nao Tomori, the student council president of a school founded as a haven for children with such abilities.

title: The Growing Pains of P.C. Penrose
description: Roy Clarke,the creator of 'Open All Hours' and 'The Last of The Summer Wine' brings another less seen comedy. New recruit PC Penrose has left his home town and joined the force in the Yorkshire town of Slagcaster. He's young and naive but seasoned staff sergeant Flagg takes him under his wing and shows him the ropes, though his methods are not the least conventional.

title: Stay with Me
description: Su Yu, a high school student who lives a simple life with his father, faces a major change when his mother remarries and introduces him to his step-brother Wu Bi. As they warm up to each other, their bond grows stronger.

title: V.C. Andrews Dawn Cutler Series
description: Dawn Longchamp has a humble life until she is suddenly thrust into a new family with dark secrets that forever alter her path.

title: My Lucky Baby Made Me a Billionaire
description:
Grace gives birth on the same day as her best friend, only to discover both babies have the same father: her husband.
Connor chooses the boy, dumps Grace and her daughter, and takes everything from her.
Big mistake.
The daughter he rejected is the real Lucky Star.
Baby Summer can summon money, predict fortune, and turn every disaster into a jackpot.
Now Grace is about to go from abandoned wife to billionaire, while the man who threw them away watches his life fall apart.
He chose the wrong baby. And now he's going to pay for it.

description: Wen Yifan, a reporter, meets Sang Yan, her former high school crush at a bar. Initially pretending not to recognize each other, circumstances lead them to become housemates. They rekindle their love and reconcile the relationship.
